Thanks for the ping. Quick notes:
- Evidence: I attached an index (SOC2-type2-evidence-index.xlsx) that maps common SIG items to SOC 2 artifacts and our internal runbooks. We can redact sensitive paths but deliver the specific artifacts referenced by the questionnaire within 48 hours for most items.
- Subprocessors: we have an up-to-date subprocessors list (will include vendor names and regions).
- Retention: our default retention matrix is in the evidence index; we can confirm customer-configurable retention for logs and embeddings if they plan to ingest PHI.

HIPAA/BAA feasibility: short answer — we do offer BAAs, but only on Dedicated or Private deployments. Requirements:
  * Customer signs our DPA + BAA (legal review, minor redlines tolerated)
  * For hosted customers the default Redwood hosted plan does not include a BAA; we can offer Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity) or Private (VPC/on-prem) with BAA.
  * Time estimate: Legal + Security approval + countersign typically ~10 business days once we have the DPA redlines. If Mediacare needs faster turnaround, we can escalate with a 48-72 hour review window but that requires a written request and internal approvals.

Action items:
- Rachel: share the specific SIG rows they flagged so I can map to artifacts.
- Vivek: can you confirm whether we need any additional controls evidence for PHI ingestion (e.g., HSM/KMS configs) beyond what SOC 2 covers?

Neha

Thanks — quick technical clarifications:
- Encryption in transit: we support TLS1.2 and TLS1.3; our load balancers terminate TLS and traffic from LB to GPU hosts is encrypted (mutual TLS internally). We can provide cipher suites and a short configuration snippet from the runtime.
- KMS/HSM: customers on Private or Dedicated can bring their own KMS or we can integrate with customer KMS via our KMS connectors; HSM-backed key storage is supported on Private.
- SOC2 artifacts: I can extract the specific evidence pack for the relevant control IDs once Neha flags which items map to SIG rows.

Also, FYI on BAA: our legal prefers referencing the Dedicated SLA and noting that PHI workloads require Dedicated/Private. I can draft a short note for Elena explaining required architecture and recommended configuration for PHI (ingestion pipeline, encryption-at-rest, access controls).

-Vivek

- DPA: attached is our current DPA with our suggested wording. We reviewed your redlines and accepted two non-material edits; remaining redlines are noted and our legal rep (Neha) flagged the one on liability cap — that's a negotiable item if you can provide procurement rationale.
- Evidence for SIG flags: we've inserted references to the SOC 2 artifacts in the attached SIG workbook. For encryption in transit we included the TLS/ciphers snippet; subprocessors list and retention matrix are in the evidence index. We can deliver the referenced artifacts (PDFs and runbook excerpts) within 48 hours after you confirm which specific rows you want in the packet.

Next steps / recommended timeline:
1) Please confirm whether Mediacare will proceed with Dedicated/Private for PHI. If yes, we will:
   - Fast-track a BAA (10 business days typical, 48-72 hour expedited possible with formal ask)
   - Provide deployment checklist for Dedicated/Private (networking, KMS options, estimated provisioning lead time)
2) If you prefer Hosted, we can continue with the DPA-only path and provide SOC2 artifacts, but we cannot sign a BAA.
3) I'll upload the DPA to DocuSign after your procurement team confirms acceptable redlines (link: https://docusign.com/envelope/0a9b8c7d).
